description: This file defines a utility class 'JsonUtils' for handling JSON operations, including converting key-value pairs to JSON objects, parsing various data types into JSON elements, and detecting Base64-encoded strings.

classes.name: JsonUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for JSON manipulation and type parsing.

methods.name: getJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a list of KeyValueProto objects into a JsonObject, handling different value types.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an Object into a JsonElement based on its runtime type, with special handling for strings and Base64 detection.

methods.name: convertToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a Map<String, ?> into a JsonObject by parsing each value.

methods.name: isBase64
methods.description: Checks if a string is Base64-encoded based on pattern matching and length.
